tradeoffs.loses: the best-effort determinism OpenAI's seed=0 asked for: Router's Responses surface has no seed field, so repeated identical prompts may now return different samples (OpenAI never guaranteed reproducibility, and the parameter was ignored on every other vendor this code can call)
tradeoffs.why: seed=0 is sent on every OpenAI-family call in ai_scientist/llm.py. The runtime keeps any request carrying seed on the provider, so without dropping it none of the app's OpenAI traffic can reach Router. The pipeline is a stochastic search (temperature 0.75, ensembles, reflection loops); it does not read or assert on reproducibility anywhere.
